RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a low-confidence subjective estimate, not a measurable probability from these facts. An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Neither does another woman’s appointment prove bias was impossible.

Your longer experience is relevant, but years alone do not establish who best meets a leadership role’s criteria. Client relationships, management skills and interview performance may legitimately matter; announcements rarely give complete qualifications.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and specific feedback. Focus on process and evidence—not panel composition. If discriminatory remarks or inconsistent treatment emerge, consider local employment advice promptly, since complaint deadlines vary.
